title: $F$-depth and $F$-nilpotent rings: generalizations and applications
summary: Computation of the Frobenius closure of ideals in rings of prime characteristic is a difficult problem. For a given ideal, its Frobenius test exponent provides a valuable degree of uniformity in performing the calculation. Hence, it is desirable to find uniform upper bounds on the Frobenius test exponent of ideals. Even in nice rings of low dimension, Brenner showed considering the collection of all ideals is generally hopeless, but for Cohen-Macaulay rings, Katzman-Sharp there are uniform upper bounds on the Frobenius test exponent for the class of parameter ideals.
